name: image
tagline_zh: 拍张照就能变成文字，连手写菜单、模糊截图都能认。不用装OCR，直接调用视觉大模型，准确到连小字都不放过。
tagline_en: Turn any photo into text—even handwritten menus or blurry screenshots. No OCR setup, just vision AI that reads.
desc_en: Extract text from images using a vision LLM
why_zh: 别人靠规则猜，它靠视觉大模型真看。手写、歪斜、低清都扛得住，省掉预处理功夫。
why_en: Others guess by rules; it truly sees via vision LLM. Handwriting, skew, low-res—handled without preprocessing.
